title: Low-Glycemic Norwegian Fatty Meat Bake
description: A rich and flavorful Norwegian dish made with fatty meat and dark soy sauce, served in a mason jar for a healthy low-glycemic twist.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Brown the bacon in a skillet over medium heat, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the cooked pork shoulder to a mason jar, leaving about 1 inch of space at the top.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs, coconut flour, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the pork shoulder in the mason jar.
Add the browned bacon, chopped onion, minced garlic, and dark soy sauce to the mason jar.
Cover the mason jar with a lid and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the mason jar from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let the meat bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the meat is cooked through.
Let the dish cool slightly before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
